environment: Windows 11 Pro for Workstations 26200 x64, Node v25.0.0
scope: W04-review.md P1 (refinement collision winner-picking), P2 (child lifecycle + wiring regressions), tmp-residue gap, writers-claim narrowing

red.p1StateLevel: test 'refinement leaves a foreign same-number handle and the collision untouched': typed shard c1 was overwritten by the current nonce (foreign binding replaced) and both shard files changed — exactly root's replay
red.p1SendPath: test 'a full-ref send through a foreign-handle conflict delivers once and hints a safe handle': sent.handle was 'c1' (the colliding handle) instead of a fresh safe 'c2'
red.tmpResidue: test 'a delivered send stays delivered...': one *.tmp scratch file survived the failed rename

fixes.reconcileRefinement: a handle whose destination key already binds a foreign conversation is not migrated at all (both sides kept byte-identical, collision still INVALID_CONVERSATION_REF); per-record migrated tracking makes old-copy cleanup remove only entries that actually moved
fixes.savePair: finally-clause removes this write's own uniquely named tmp when the rename did not consume it; target shard and foreign files untouched; best-effort semantics unchanged
fixes.runChild: independent 30s timeout (kill+reject), error-event reject, settles on close (pipes drained), 64KiB output cap, CROSSCHAT_LIVE cleared from child env
fixes.holderHook: bounded 5s deadline in the generated preload instead of an unbounded spin
fixes.afterAll: kills remaining children, awaits close (5s cap) before recursively deleting owned roots (tmpdir-direct-child + crosschat-conv-lock- prefix check)

wiringRegressions: full-ref send through a foreign-handle conflict: delivered exactly once to the correct target, hint is a fresh safe handle c2, ambiguous c1 rejected with zero delivery
same-nonce three-process concurrent reuse: one handle, every child resolves it back to the same full ref
refinement vs same-nonce refresh race (Promise.all): exactly one c1 remains, resolving to the typed conversation, no stale copy in the old shard
pre-lock failure: sendMessage rejects CONVERSATION_STATE_BUSY with zero native delivery while a real holder occupies the lock; after release the same send delivers exactly once
post-delivery accounting failure (local): delivery side-effect turns the shard path into a directory — status stays delivered, exactly one delivery, no resend, no tmp residue
SSH receipt then local accounting+handle failure: sendViaSsh keeps delivered, handle undefined, exactly one ssh leg, no tmp residue
TCP receipt then local accounting+handle failure: sendViaTcp keeps delivered, handle undefined, exactly one broker delivery (counted), no tmp residue
stuck holder exits within its own deadline and still completes its allocation; unloadable child script settles non-zero instead of hanging
writersClaim: The lock domain covers exactly the four conversation write APIs (handleForRef, claimHandle, continueFromRef incl. reconcileRefinement, recordConversation). Concurrent maintenance deletion (cleanup/force-clean in src/commands/clean.ts via maintenance/operations.ts) is an explicitly excluded pre-existing boundary: its contract already allows deleting files mid-write when no transport is running; W04-R1 did not change clean/force-clean parameters, execution semantics, output or preview.
limits: Windows x64 / Node v25.0.0 only; Linux/macOS not executed (platform CI task remains root's).
Single-machine mutex; a network-shared state root across machines remains out of scope.
Multi-process contention tests are real-process regressions; the deterministic lock-discipline evidence is the holder test.
